misprints.note: Diminutive of πατάνη, which is printed just before it; the print clearly has ο in the first syllable.
Diminutive of λοπάς; the initial letter is clearly κ in the print.
The print has no ι before ν.
The accent is printed on the first syllable and there is no circumflex on ου.
The letter is κ: it has no descender.

uncertain.note: The mark over ι in 'παροψίς, ίδος' looks like a plain acute, not a breathing.
There is a stray dot above the punctuation after σπανίζειν τινός, probably dust. I transcribed it as an ordinary stop.
The print uses '' '' quotation marks. I kept them as straight double quotes.
